name: sdf-film-grain
description: Film grain: a per-pixel integer-hashed offset added over the rendered output. The hash is a pure function of pixel cell, grain frame, and seed, so it renders identically on both backends.

size.description: The grain cell size, in pixels.

seed.description: Folded into the per-pixel hash; two worlds with different seeds grain differently.

flickerHz.description: How many times per second the grain pattern advances. The pattern is keyed on the engine tick, so a frame carries the grain of the flicker period its tick falls in; a rate that does not divide the tick rate advances every whole number of ticks nearest below its period.
